title: Access and trunk ports
content:
# Access and trunk ports

## Desk port (PC plus IP phone)

```
interface GigabitEthernet1/0/10
 description DESK
 switchport mode access
 switchport access vlan 10
 switchport voice vlan 20
 spanning-tree portfast
 spanning-tree bpduguard enable
 no shutdown
```

## Uplink trunk (access stack to distribution)

```
interface TenGigabitEthernet1/1/1
 description UPLINK-hq-dist-a
 switchport mode trunk
 switchport trunk native vlan 998
 switchport trunk allowed vlan 10,20,30,40,50,99
 ip dhcp snooping trust
 no shutdown
```

## Unused ports

```
interface range GigabitEthernet1/0/40 - 48
 description UNUSED
 switchport mode access
 switchport access vlan 999
 shutdown
```

| Port type | VLANs | PortFast | BPDU guard |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Desk | 10 + voice 20 | Yes | Yes |
| Access point | Trunk 30,40,99 | No | No |
| Printer | 50 | Yes | Yes |
| Uplink | Trunk, native 998 | No | No |

VLAN meanings are in [[VLAN plan]]. DHCP snooping is part of the [[Security baseline]].
